final: WITH g AS (SELECT city_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM address GROUP BY city_id), a AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM g), r AS (SELECT g.city_id, g.cnt, g.cnt * 1.0 / a.avg_cnt AS ratio_avg FROM g JOIN a ON a.avg_cnt IS NOT NULL), t AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM r) SELECT r.city_id, r.cnt, r.ratio_avg, r.cnt * 1.0 / t.total AS ratio_total FROM r JOIN t ON t.total IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ratio_total DESC, r.city_id LIMIT 10
